analysis.headline: A year after Carlos Manzo's killing, investigators tie the Uruapan mayor's murder to CJNG revenge and count 34 detained
analysis.what_happened: Uruapan mayor Carlos Manzo was shot dead on 1 November 2025 by a 17-year-old, and authorities attribute the killing to the CJNG. El País and Infobae report an encrypted chat, a hard drive and 34 detentions, including people from his close circle.
analysis.says_vs_does: Excélsior reports investigators call the case 90% solved and describe it as CJNG revenge for the August 2025 arrest of plaza boss René Belmontes, El Rhino. Sources here do not say whether whoever ordered the killing has been charged.
analysis.follow_the_money: Sources do not give a figure.
analysis.at_stake: The CJNG, in succession since El Mencho's death, lost its Uruapan plaza boss before the killing and dozens of operatives after it. Manzo's family and movement remain split over his political legacy, Contramuro and the Los Angeles Times report.
tensions: CJNG vs Uruapan's local government: the mayor confronted the group directly during his year in office, Milenio reports.
State prosecutors vs FGR: the federal prosecutor did not take over the case, according to Excélsior.
